nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: GAMLSS (Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape) was used to simultaneously model the parameters (mean, standard deviation, skew, and kurtosis) of the distribution as response variables. The model uses a sinh-arcsinh (shash) distribution which allows for non-normal modelling. The mean and standard deviation depend on sex (fixed effect), site (random effect), and smooth functions of age. The skew depends on sex (fixed effect) and smooth function of age. The kurtosis depends on smooth function of age only.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Generalized additive models for location scale and shape (GAMLSS) using the gamlss package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gamlss/) were used to simultaneously model the parameters (mean, standard deviation, skew, and kurtosis) of the distribution as response variables of the explanatory variables sex, age, and scanning site.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness, cortical volume, and pial surface area; additional morphology components K, I, and S (not in predefined list).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The aparcstats2table command was used to generate measures of cortical thickness, cortical volume, and pial surface area, for  68  brain  regions according  to  the  Desikan-  Killiany parcellation  atlas  (  Desikan    et  al.,    2006). ... We used the toolbox developed by   Wang   et al.   (2021) (https:// github  .  com  /  cnnp  -  lab  /  CorticalFoldingAnalysisT ools) to calculate K, I, and S for each hemisphere.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Little2025.pdf.md: 2.2. Pre- processing; Little2025.pdf.md: 2.3. Cortical morphology measures

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model uses sex as a fixed effect, site/batch as a random effect, and smooth functions of age. Specifically: mean depends on sex (fixed effect), site (random effect), and smooth function of age; standard deviation depends on sex (fixed effect), site (random effect), and smooth function of age; skew depends on sex (fixed effect) and smooth function of age; kurtosis depends on smooth function of age only.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Specifically, in our model, the mean depends on sex (fixed effect), site (random effect), and a smooth function of age; the standard deviation depends on sex (fixed effect), site (random effect), and a smooth function of age; the skew depends on sex (fixed effect) and a smooth function of age; and the kurtosis depends on a smooth function of age.
